tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App and page background. Rice white, never pure white: easier on older eyes under bright light.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, list rows, input fields on ground.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Search fields, wells, the area behind a focused person in the tree.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and unselected chips: 3:1 or better on ground and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and icons. Banyan-bark green-black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ground, surface and sunk. Never below 15px.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary actions, selected tab, links. Banyan green.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected chip and highlighted row backgrounds; brand text sits on it.

tokens.name: manjal
tokens.usage: Turmeric yellow. The one celebratory accent: today's birthday, the 'you' marker in the tree, the add button on Android.

tokens.name: on-manjal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on manjal and on chakka.

tokens.name: chethi
tokens.usage: Branch colour 1 (ixora red). Also destructive actions and errors.

tokens.name: vazha
tokens.usage: Branch colour 2 (banana leaf). Also success.

tokens.name: kayal
tokens.usage: Branch colour 3 (backwater teal).

tokens.name: mazha
tokens.usage: Branch colour 4 (monsoon indigo). Also informational notices.

tokens.name: chakka
tokens.usage: Branch colour 5 (jackfruit). Takes on-manjal text, not on-branch.

tokens.name: kadalas
tokens.usage: Branch colour 6 (bougainvillea).

tokens.name: on-branch
tokens.usage: Initials and labels on chethi, vazha, kayal, mazha and kadalas fills.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 3px, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

families.text: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Anek Malayalam", "Noto Sans Malayalam", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: onboarding and the family name on Home.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Screen titles (iOS large title, Android top app bar when expanded).

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Section headings, person name on a profile.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Add your mother, father, husband or wife, and children.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text. The app's base size is 18px, not 16.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, tab labels, field labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The smallest text allowed anywhere. Relation lines, helper text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; between a name and its relation line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside list rows, between avatar and text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin on phones; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards and sections; screen side margin on tablets.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Above a section heading.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top of onboarding screens.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Minimum height AND width of anything tappable. Not 44, not 48.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips' inner badges, small thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, list cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Feature cards, bottom sheets (top corners), the iOS floating tab bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, and every person: people are always discs.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only for things that float above content: the iOS tab bar, the Android add button, sheets. Cards use line, not shadow.
